# College of Science - University of the Philippines Diliman

> The College of Science at UP Diliman is a premier institution for scientific research and education, housing multiple institutes in biology, chemistry, physics, and marine science with focus on advanced research including forensic DNA analysis and molecular biotechnology.

The College of Science, established in 1983, serves as the academic and research hub for the University of the Philippines Diliman's natural sciences programs. It offers undergraduate and graduate education across multiple institutes and coordinates major research initiatives in Southeast Asia.

## Key Topics

- National Institute of Physics (NIP)
- Institute of Biology
- Institute of Chemistry
- National Institute of Geological Sciences
- Natural Sciences Research Institute
- National Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnology
- Massively Parallel Sequencing (MPS)
- DNA Forensics
- DOST ASTHRDP Scholarship
- Graduate and Undergraduate Programs
- Research and Development
- Academic Calendar and Enrollment
- Director Search and Nominations
- Southeast Asian Science
- Science Technology Innovation
